ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the B1-1,
Neighborhood Shopping Districts; B3-2, Community Shopping Districts; M1-2, Limited
Manufacturing/Business Park Districts; and C1-2, Neighborhood Commercial Districts
symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 18-B and Map No. 20-B in the area bound

by:

South Escanaba Avenue; a line 132 feet north of and parallel to East 79" Street;
a line 87 feet east of and parallel to South Escanaba Avenue; East 79" Street;
South Exchange Avenue; the alley next north of and parallel to East Cheltenham
Place; a line 150 feet east of and parallel to South Exchange Avenue; South
Cheltenham Avenue; South Coles Avenue; East 79" Street; South Commercial
Avenue; East 80" Street; the alley next east of and parallel to South Exchange
Avenue; a line 149 feet north of and parallel to East 81% Street; South Exchange
Avenue; East 80" Street; the alley next west of and parallel to South Exchange
Avenue; and a line 125 feet south of and parallel to East 79" Street,

to those of a B2-3, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District,

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.
